# Onibex ASK

> A deterministic Text-to-SQL agent and the accompanying YAML specification
> for AI-ready SAP data products. Resolves natural-language questions
> against a curated semantic layer (Bronze/Silver/Gold) via OpenSearch hybrid
> search and a deterministic entity-relationship graph, compiling SQL from
> resolved fields — the LLM maps to the semantic layer, it never invents
> tables or columns.

Source-available (PolyForm Strict / Free Trial); a commercial license is
required for production or other commercial use — see [Licensing](#licensing)
below before integrating this project into a product or service.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): repository overview — platform + specification, how
  they relate.
- [Platform README](platform/README.md): the runtime — orchestrator,
  admin/chat/setup SPAs, the three SQL-generation modes (flash/precise/smart).
- [Getting Started](platform/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): bring up the stack
  locally or via `docker compose up`.
- [ASK Specification](definition/README.md): the Bronze/Silver/Gold YAML
  contract for the semantic layer.
